entities.name: Arcus
entities.description: Wizard of Mors Ridge and member of its High Council; teacher of Ad'amra.

entities.name: Mors Ridge
entities.description: Town attacked in the Battle at Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Red Donald
entities.description: Told the Legend of Mors Ridge by Arcus.

entities.name: Ad'amra
entities.description: Student of Arcus's magic who receives a map to Rhuell's cave.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Leader of the orc and undead horde that attacked Mors Ridge.

entities.name: Ham
entities.description: Appeared in false human form; actually the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Fought Rhuell and Palladia-Mors during the attack.

entities.name: Battle at Mors Ridge
entities.description: Battle in which Palladia-Mors's horde attacked the city.

events.summary: Palladia-Mors's horde of orcs and undead attacks Mors Ridge.
events.quote: horde of orcs and undead attacked the city.

events.summary: Arcus casts a spell transforming Ham back into the Elder Dragon Chromium Rhuell.
events.quote: Arcus cast a spell, transforming Ham from his false human form

events.summary: Arcus gives Ad'amra a map to the cave where Rhuell went after the battle.
events.quote: He then gave Ad’amra a map

relations.note: He was a member of the council.
relations.quote: Arcus was a member of the High Council of Mors Ridge
